summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) across 5 planned fixes for unpin integrity bugs and IPNS subtree unenrollment gaps, then run the full post-execution quality pipeline (code review, verification, validation, simplify, security reviews).
summary.outcome: Phase 50 fully executed and shipped: 5 plans merged via parallel worktrees, 2 blocker code-review findings (cycle guard, missing .catch) fixed, 90/90 tests green, verification passed on all 3 must-haves, Nyquist-compliant, security reviews found no exploitable vulnerabilities. Phase marked complete, 2 resolved todos closed.

repo: GSD dep-string parsing is fragile: 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' gets mis-parsed into a phantom phase '1.1', incorrectly marking dependencies unsatisfied even when Phase 49 is complete.

Worktrees have no own node_modules — pnpm/orval resolve to the workspace root, so invoking pnpm api:generate inside a worktree leaks 131+ generated api-client files and any SDK output directly into the main checkout's working tree.
Husky regenerates .husky/_/* stub files as untracked inside worktrees when pnpm install is triggered; these block the cleanup-wave merge helper with a dirty-working-tree error.

The cleanup-wave merge helper silently fails (opaque 'merge_failed', no stderr) when the pre-commit hook times out or fails internally — the staged content is clean and the fix is to complete the merge commit manually with hooks enabled.
gsd_run query commit reliably reports commit_failed but actually succeeds — always verify via git log rather than trusting the helper's exit status.
todos/done/ (70 legacy items, last touched 2026-06-15) and todos/completed/ (canonical, referenced 6× in GSD tooling) drifted apart; GSD always writes to completed/, done/ was never migrated.
Markdownlint ignores .planning/ directory so planning-doc commits never trigger lint-staged failures.
The VALIDATION.md grep for 'outboxRowInserted' hit a documenting comment 'renamed from outboxRowInserted' at vault.service.ts:251 even after the rename, producing a false-positive gap report.
cleanup-wave requires a fully clean orchestrator working tree including STATE.md; the orchestrator's own state.begin-phase write blocks the first merge attempt.

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync lacked a visited Set guard (unlike ensureFolderLoaded at line 549 and the shared walker at line 2526), making it vulnerable to infinite recursion on folder-metadata cycles. Fixed by CR-01: visited Set added at line 293-294, child-skip at 327-341.

Four fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites (lines ~220, 246, 316+) used .then() with no .catch(), causing unhandled promise rejections that violated the 'failures never block the caller' contract. Fixed by CR-02, then further refactored into a single fireAndForgetUnenrollEntries helper by /simplify.

WR-01: drain re-checked pinned_cids count and called unpinFile in autocommit with no advisory lock — TOCTOU window where concurrent re-upload could cause Kubo GC of a live CID. Fixed by wrapping recheck+unpin+delete in a transaction that first takes pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)::bigint).

Documenting comment 'renamed from outboxRowInserted' (IN-06) caused VALIDATION.md grep assertions to false-positive, appearing as a gap even though the actual variable was correctly renamed to shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin at lines 254/306/312.

workflow: When a worktree's pnpm run leaks generated files into the main checkout, verify all dirty files match the expected worktree branch before discarding them — this avoids accidentally discarding legitimate changes.

Post-merge build/typecheck gate (pnpm -r run build chain + web tsc -b) is the real cross-plan integration check after worktree merges; targeted unit tests alone don't catch type/import breakage from api-client regen.
Running full monorepo parallel test suites (pnpm --parallel -r run test) risks RAM starvation and hits infra-dependent integration tests; prefer targeted per-package runs for post-merge gates.
The /simplify pass after code-review fixes is a valuable sequencing choice: CR-02's four .catch() handlers became easier to consolidate into one helper after they were all co-located by the fix.

friction: Dep-string mis-parsing ('Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' → phantom phase '1.1') required manually confirming readiness instead of trusting the dashboard recommendation.
Worktree pnpm api:generate leaking 131 api-client files + client.ts into main checkout required manual per-file verification before discarding, adding ~10 min of diagnostic work.
Husky .husky/_/* stubs regenerated as untracked in worktrees blocked cleanup-wave with an opaque dirty-state error.
cleanup-wave merge helper produced silent 'merge_failed' (empty stderr) on pre-commit hook timeout for 131 generated files — required diagnosing via manual git merge + inspecting staged state.
cleanup-wave also blocked because orchestrator STATE.md was dirty from state.begin-phase write.
gsd_run query commit false-negative on every commit required verifying via git log after each call.
macOS mktemp left XXXXXX literal in filename when template had X's mid-string (BSD mktemp limitation).
VALIDATION.md grep assertions false-positived on a documenting comment for a renamed variable, requiring manual inspection to confirm the rename was actually done.
